value.rationale: Wheel graphs form a canonical infinite family with overlapping facial circulations. Their exact relative ℓ1 cycle-space complementation constants are a natural structural Banach-space invariant. The theorem gives an infinite family classification, an unexpected exact stabilization at six rim vertices, and explicit matching primal/dual witnesses. The result is not merely a restatement of the general quotient representation, standard averaging, or a single arbitrary finite calculation.
